def assign_customers_to_routes(instance, depot, customer_ids, station_ids):
    routes = []
    current_route = [depot]
    current_battery = instance.vehicle.initial_soc
    
    for cid in customer_ids:
        customer = instance.node_map[cid]
        next_node = instance.node_map[current_route[-1]]
        travel_distance = distance(next_node, customer)
        travel_energy = energy_required(next_node, customer, instance.vehicle)
        
        if current_battery - travel_energy >= 0:
            current_route.append(cid)
            current_battery -= travel_energy
        else:
            # Find the nearest charging station
            nearest_station = min(station_ids, key=lambda sid: distance(instance.node_map[sid], customer))
            current_route.append(nearest_station)
            current_battery = full_recharge(instance.vehicle)
            current_route.append(cid)
            current_battery -= travel_energy
        
        # Check if the route can return to the depot
        return_distance = distance(customer, instance.node_map[depot])
        return_energy = energy_required(customer, instance.node_map[depot], instance.vehicle)
        
        if current_battery - return_energy >= 0:
            current_route.append(depot)
            routes.append(current_route)
            current_route = [depot]
            current_battery = instance.vehicle.initial_soc
        
    if current_route and current_route[-1] != depot:
        current_route.append(depot)
        routes.append(current_route)
    
    return routes

            route.insert(route.index(state.node_id), nearest_station)
            # Recalculate the route states after recharge
            states = propagate_route(instance, route)
